```artifact
Feature: System Security and Functionality

  Scenario: Chemist and Lab Login
    Given a Chemist or Lab user with a valid username and password
    When the user logs into the system
    Then the user should be able to access the Prescriptions

  Scenario: Patient Login
    Given a Patient with a valid username and password
    When the user logs into the system
    Then the user should be able to access the Prescriptions

  Scenario: Email Notification for Patients
    Given a Patient with a valid email address
    When a prescription is generated for the patient
    Then an email should be sent to the patient's email address
    And the email should contain the full prescription and Invoice

  Scenario: Payment Gateway Integration
    Given a valid payment method (Debit/Credit Card/Net banking)
    When the user selects the payment method
    Then the payment should be securely accepted

  Scenario: Django 2.0 Usage
    Given the system is running on Django 2.0
    When the system is started
    Then Django 2.0 should be used

  Scenario: MySQL Usage
    Given the system is using MySQL
    When the system is started
    Then MySQL should be used

  Scenario: Browser Compatibility
    Given a user is using a supported browser (Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Safari, etc.)
    When the user accesses the system
    Then the system should be accessible

  Scenario: OS Compatibility
    Given a user is using a supported operating system
    When the user accesses the system
    Then the system should be accessible

  Scenario Outline: Normal Login
    Given a user with username "<username>" and password "<password>"
    When the user logs into the system
    Then the user should be able to access the Prescriptions

    Examples:
      | username | password |
      | valid_chemist | valid_password |
      | valid_patient | valid_password |

  Scenario Outline: Edge Login
    Given a user with username "<username>" and password "<password>"
    When the user logs into the system
    Then the user should be able to access the Prescriptions

    Examples:
      | username | password |
      | "" | "" |
      | "admin" | "admin123" |

  Scenario Outline: Invalid Login
    Given a user with username "<username>" and password "<password>"
    When the user logs into the system
    Then the login should fail

    Examples:
      | username | password |
      | invalid_user | invalid_password |
      | "" | valid_password |

  Scenario Outline: Normal Email Notification
    Given a patient with username "<patient_id>"
    When a prescription is generated for the patient
    Then an email should be sent to the patient's email address
    And the email should contain the full prescription and Invoice

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | valid_patient_id |

  Scenario Outline: Edge Email Notification
    Given a patient with username "<patient_id>"
    When a prescription is generated for the patient
    Then an email should be sent to the patient's email address
    And the email should contain the full prescription and Invoice

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | "" |
      | "nonexistent_patient" |

  Scenario Outline: Invalid Email Notification
    Given a patient with username "<patient_id>"
    When a prescription is generated for the patient
    Then an email should not be sent to the patient's email address

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | invalid_patient_id |
      | "" |
```
